An unusual rearrangement process consistent with a formal [1,7]-silyl migration from the C7 to C6 position of the azulene framework was observed during the course of the transformation. The synthetic utility of the method was demonstrated by further transforming the resulting silylated azulene derivatives into a variety of 1functionalized azulenes. This study provides a new strategy for constructing and functionalizing azulene skeletons as well as new insight into the reactivities of cyclopropanone-derived intermediates.
items.authors: Yuki Sato, Sayaka Ohrui, Masanori Tayu, Satoshi Yagi, Mutsuki Kato, Kuniyoshi Miki

items.title: The CO₂ Concentration Inversion Effect: *CO Generation Rate and *CO C–C Coupling Efficiency as Dual Kinetic Descriptors for Catalyst-Dependent C₂₊ Selectivity in Dilute CO₂ Electroreduction¹
items.abstract: The electrochemical reduction of dilute CO₂ (5–33% v/v) to multicarbon (C₂₊) products offers a sustainable route to directly utilize industrial exhaust, bypassing energy-intensive CO₂ capture and purification. Our systematic investigations from 2023 to 2026 reveal a counter-intuitive paradigm: under dilute CO2 feed ranging (e.g. from 25% to pure CO2), the C2+ selectivity of copper-based catalysts not only matches but can surpass the pure CO2 baseline. Here, we define the CO₂ Concentration Inversion Effect: a kinetic regime where the FE(C₂₊)/FE(C₁) ratio under dilute CO₂ feed exceeds that under pure CO₂ at identical potentials. This non-monotonic selectivity demonstrates that C₂₊ formation is governed by a catalyst-tunable balance between *CO supply and coupling kinetics. Critically, we introduce two quantitative kinetic descriptors that jointly govern the fate of *CO intermediates: the *CO production rate (the total flux of *CO supplied to the surface) and the C-C coupling efficiency of *CO (the fraction of that *CO consumed by C-C coupling). While the definitions of these descriptors are general, their joint systematic quantification and mechanistic application as a dual-descriptor framework represent a significant advance. We demonstrate that C2+ selectivity is synergistically controlled by both the *CO generation rate and the *CO C-C coupling efficiency, both of which are modulated by applied potential and local reaction environments. In-situ FT-IR spectroscopy and systematic pH-dependent measurements reveal that the coupling efficiency is primarily governed by CO2 concentration rather than bulk pH, although the boundaries of the inversion window (Cmin, Cpeak, Cmax) shift with electrolyte conditions. Notably, we resolve a mechanistic decoupling between microscopic coupling efficiency and macroscopic FE(C2+)/FE(C1) ratios: while coupling efficiency reflects the intrinsic branching ratio of *CO intermediates, the macroscopic selectivity is optimized at an intermediate *CO supply where the absolute flux and suppression of competing C1 pathways dominate. This framework, validated across diverse catalyst families including B-doped Cu, Ag@Cu2O, and Cu(OH)2-derived Cu, establishes five key advances: (i) the explicit definition of coupling efficiency as a quantitative ratio, alongside *CO production rate; (ii) its absolute quantification across CO2 concentrations; (iii) cross-system validation of the dual-descriptor framework; (iv) the elucidation of the decoupling between efficiency and selectivity at high *CO coverage; and (v) their use as design criteria for catalyst optimization. This framework suggests that optimizing the *CO supply-coupling balance at dilute concentrations may offer distinct advantages for carbon upcycling compared to incremental improvements under pure feeds.
items.authors: Qing Yu, Ying Zhang, Peng Zhu, Qiankang Zhang

items.title: TLQ Method: A Tandem Mixing–Linear Deduction–Quantile Weighted Median Framework for Robust Metabolite Screening and a General Diagnostic Indicator for Measurement Reliability
items.abstract: Untargeted metabolomics is constrained by inter-individual variability, difficulty in detecting low-abundance metabolites, and matrix effects. Post-acquisition corrections are limited when biological variation is large, signals approach detection limits, or matrix effects are strong. We propose the TLQ method, consisting of Tandem Mixing, Linear Deduction, and Quantile Quality-Weighted Median. Tandem Mixing compresses between-group matrix differences and enhances low-abundance signals via equal-volume mixing of paired samples. Linear Deduction removes background and back-calculates the treatment signal, yielding a deduced fold change closer to the true treatment-to-control ratio. The third module performs robust screening using a quality-weighted median with Bootstrap confidence intervals. A candidates-of-interest mechanism improves coverage without compromising accuracy. The modules can be deployed flexibly (paired mode, P_R mode, or standalone third module). We also propose a general group-level diagnostic indicator (GDI) framework. GDI compares pooled and individual estimates and normalizes their discrepancy against a stochastic expectation, making systematic distortion quantifiable. GDI is platform-independent and serves as an independent reliability annotation layer in the TLQ method..
items.authors: Teng Teng, Yuchun Lu, Tonglei Qiao, Chun-E Liu, Feng Liu

items.title: A substrate-first-enzymology deep-learning framework for transforming new-to-nature chemicals
items.abstract: Enzyme activity data favor familiar substrates and positive outcomes, creating survivorship bias that limits predictions for new-to-nature chemistry. Here we introduce substrate-first enzymology: a chemically diverse substrate array is designed to broaden coverage of a predefined, synthetically relevant chemical space, independently of expected activity. Alcohol dehydrogenases (ADHs) are systematically assayed against this array using a unified high-throughput assay. The enzyme–substrate matrix records activity labels and turnover frequency ( k cat ) values; substrate-resolved profiles form an ADH k cat atlas. A deep learning model trained on these data classifies activity and predicts k cat for active pairs. The model outperforms existing approaches under matched training and evaluation conditions and prospectively prioritizes active substrates from underrepresented chemical space. Without binding-pocket annotations, the model’s attention mechanism highlights substrate reactive centers and catalytically relevant residues. By designing substrate coverage before measurement and retaining both positive and negative outcomes, this framework reduces historical sampling bias and supports interpretable k cat prediction beyond historically sampled chemistry.
items.authors: You-Xue Zhao, Hao-Yue Wang, Luo-Bing Meng, Yu-Xin Jia, Xi-Ruo Li, Jia-Ming Yang

items.title: Machine-learning force-field scoring rivals free-energy perturbation for congeneric ligand ranking across public benchmarks
items.abstract: Relative binding free-energy (RBFE) methods such as free-energy perturbation (FEP) set the accuracy standard for ranking congeneric ligands in structurebased drug design, but their computational cost limits throughput. Machine-learned force fields (MLFFs) now approach quantum-chemical accuracy at a small fraction of that cost, raising the question of whether they can recover much of RBFE’s ranking accuracy while remaining computationally efficient. We introduce a static-score methodology called taqo and benchmark 10 MLFF variants spanning 6 model families (UMA, MACE, Orb, eSEN, AIMNet2, AllScAIP), together with a classical molecular-mechanics force field, on a uniform staticpocket protocol, correlated against experiment across 22 benchmark systems.We find that the ten MLFFs cannot be resolved from one another at this sample size, while every one of them significantly outranks the classical force field reference, at a few seconds per ligand on a single GPU. Against published OpenFE and FEP+ results on the same systems and the same ligand sets, taqo is statistically indistinguishable from OpenFE and significantly below FEP+, at roughly three orders of magnitude lower cost. On the congeneric JACS subset taqo and FEP+ are statistically indistinguishable. On the same benchmark poses taqo outperforms classical docking scores and is statistically indistinguishable from deep-learning affinity models, without any affinity-specific training. Together these establish MLFF interaction-energy scoring as a practical high-throughput approach for lead optimization.
items.authors: Kevin Ryczko, Sarah Maier, Amogh Sood, Patrick Rowe, Harish Ramadas, Lorenzo Boninsegna

items.title: Accessing room-temperature phosphorescence via a modular quinoline-amine scaffold
items.abstract: Cinchona alkaloids have played an important part in the history of fluorescence studies and the recent discovery of their long-lived emission makes them a useful tool for exploring new applications in labelling and tagging. Furthermore, they are excellent model systems for exploring the fundamental nature of charge transfer due to the through-space charge transfer between the nitrogen atom on the cage and the quinoline aryl group. However, the synthetic routes and pathways to modification are cumbersome and new synthetic routes are required. Here we demonstrate new synthetic pathways to create a wide range of unnatural quinine analogues giving control over the chromophore point of attachment and N-aryl distance. Furthermore the molecules demonstrate long-lived emission confirming that we are capturing some of the novel photophysical properties of their natural analogues.
items.authors: Ruth Pollard, Jinghan Lin, Philipp Wieland, Ashanti Leone, Paul Waddell, Mark Sims
items.title_zh: 通过模块化喹啉-胺骨架实现室温磷光发射
items.summary_zh: 金鸡纳碱在荧光研究历史中发挥了重要作用，最近发现其长寿命发射使其成为探索标记和标签新应用的有用工具。此外，它们是研究电荷转移基本性质的优秀模型系统，因为在氮原子与喹啉芳基之间存在空间电荷转移。然而，合成路线和改性路径繁琐，需要新的合成路线。本文展示了新的合成路径，创造出多种非天然奎宁类似物，能够控制色素的连接点和N-芳基距离。此外，这些分子表现出长寿命发射，确认我们捕捉到了其天然类似物的一些新颖光物理特性。

items.title: Nucleation of Condensates and Voids: A Generalised Critical Cluster Equivalence Principle for Phase Separation in Liquid Mixtures
items.abstract: The assembly, number density, and size distribution of biomolecular condensates are central to their biological functions, but the nucleation kinetics that precede growth and coalescence remain difficult to characterise experimentally and in simulations. In this work, we develop a theoretical framework to apply the critical cluster equivalence principle (CEP), which builds on the thermodynamic equivalence between stable clusters in confined systems and critical clusters in open systems, to multicomponent liquids undergoing phase separation into solvent-and solute-rich phases. We first test the proposed approach in a symmetric Lennard-Jones mixture, where nucleation rates agree with large-scale Yasuoka–Matsumoto simulations and the predicted critical cluster sizes match independent seeding results. We then use the validated approach to investigate a homopolymeric chainsolvent system, introducing concepts intrinsic to biomolecular condensates such as chain rigidity and connectivity. Here, the CEP predicts the coexistence composition and interfacial tension for both the forward nucleation of dense condensates and the reverse formation of dilute voids, indicating that the curvature dependence is consistent in both directions, thereby uncovering a forward/reverse relationship that has primarily been studied for single-component droplets and bubbles, now demonstrated for a compositionally mixed liquid phase separation. Overall, the CEP-based workflow employs smaller systems and shorter simulations than conventional nucleation methods. These findings indicate a comprehensive methodology for quantitatively examining biomolecular condensate nucleation in explicit solvent.
items.authors: Lunna Li, Erik E. Santiso, Matteo Salvalaglio

items.title: Hyperlocal PM2.5 Exposure and Health Burden Disparities Revealed by a Taxi-Based Mobile Monitoring Platform in Shenzhen
items.abstract: Although fine particles (PM 2.5 ) concentrations in China have declined over the past decade, exposure disparities persist at hyperlocal scales. We conducted a six-month mobile monitoring campaign in Shenzhen, where four taxis with calibrated low-cost sensors gathered 24.6 million 1 Hz measurements (~3,700 hours) across 550 km² and 7.3 million residents. We developed a novel application of a multi-source XGBoost (MS-XGB) framework that integrates mobile and fixed-site station data to reconstruct a road-network PM 2.5 dataset at 30 m × 1 h resolution, filling 98% of missing observations. Validation demonstrates strong agreement with both mobile observations (R 2 = 0.97) and data from fixed regulatory monitoring stations (Pearson r = 0.82). We used the road-network dataset to generate a 100 m × 100 m population grid exposure map and benchmarked it against two conventional exposure assessment approaches that rely solely on fixed-site regulatory stations. Relative to MS-XGB, conventional methods systematically underestimated long-term PM 2.5 exposure, with grid-level differences of up to 15 μg/m³. Population-weighted mean exposure was higher in urban villages (16.51 µg/m³) than in other urban areas (14.41 µg/m³), with hotspots 52.5% more likely to occur in urban villages. In Longhua, high exposure was concentrated specifically in urban villages, indicating that district-level averages can mask substantial intra-district heterogeneity. In Nanshan, 40% of elderly residents live in high-exposure areas, compared with 34% of children aged 0–14 and 33% of adults aged 15–59, suggesting that older adults bear a disproportionate exposure burden and face elevated health risks. Our findings demonstrate that mobile-monitoring-based hyperlocal exposure assessment is essential for revealing true PM 2.5 exposure inequalities across population groups and spatial environments that are overlooked by conventional fixed-site approaches.
items.authors: Zilin Guo, Ziyang Jiang, Shutong Zheng, Tongshu Zheng, Yutong Liang

items.title: Agentic Workflow for High-Throughput Synthesis Campaigns: Mapping the Persistent Phosphor Ca2ZnSi2O7:Eu2+,Nd3+
items.abstract: The structural and spectroscopic record of a high-throughput synthesis campaign exceeds what experimenters can closely and accurately analyze with conventional tools alone. We report a workflow built for this problem: a language model agent operates an automated Rietveld phasesearch pipeline, Crystalyze Match, built on the open-source DARA engine, and then interprets the phases, optical spectra, and synthesis metadata. We demonstrate this workflow on a 48 sample campaign for the persistent phosphor Ca 2 ZnSi 2 O 7 :Eu 2+ ,Nd 3+ (doped hardystonite), a water-stable candidate alternative to SrAl 2 O 4 :Eu 2+ ,Dy 3+ for luminescent road markings. Within the campaign’s lifetime, the workflow mapped two decomposition pathways, incomplete reaction and zinc volatilization, that validate the two-step synthetic approach. The workflow also identified the fate of the rare-earth dopants: a silicate oxyapatite, Ca 2 (Eu,Nd) 8 (SiO 4 ) 6 O 2 , missed by prior manual analysis, is present in every doped sample. Human adjudication proved necessary as the search first scored the oxyapatite through a lanthanide-free proxy structure that scatters too weakly to register at low fractions, and a corrected-model re-screen of all 48 patterns recovered it. Though the rare-earth dopants appear to end up in the oxyapatite phase, emission rises monotonically with Eu content, and the material shows the target persistent luminescence, so where the emitting Eu 2+ resides remains unresolved. Our work highlights that human review and re-screening after every structure-model revision dramatically improve the trustworthiness of campaign-scale claims.
items.authors: Ziyang Jiang, Eric Riesel, Ian Naccarella, Taylor D. Sparks
items.title_zh: 高通量合成中的自主工作流程：持久磷光体Ca2ZnSi2O7:Eu2+,Nd3+的研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究针对高通量合成活动中结构和光谱数据的记录，提出了一种自主工作流程。该流程利用语言模型代理操作基于开源DARA引擎的自动Rietveld相搜索管道Crystalyze Match，并对相位、光谱和合成元数据进行解读。我们在48个样品的合成活动中应用该工作流程，研究了持久磷光体Ca2ZnSi2O7:Eu2+,Nd3+（掺锌硬石膏），作为SrAl2O4:Eu2+,Dy3+的水稳定替代品。该流程映射了两个分解路径，验证了两步合成方法，并发现每个掺杂样品中均存在一种先前手动分析未能识别的稀土掺杂物：硅酸盐氧磷灰石Ca2(Eu,Nd)8(SiO4)6O2。尽管稀土掺杂物最终似乎进入氧磷灰石相，但发射强度随着Eu含量单调增加。

items.title: Enhancing Aromatics Production in Zeolite-Catalyzed Lignin Pyrolysis by Establishing Structure-Acidity-Performance Relationships
items.abstract: Selective pyrolysis of lignin into aromatics remains a major challenge due to its high oxygen content and structural complexity. Solid acid catalysts, like zeolites, are well known as effective catalysts for pyrolysis processes. However, the role of acid site density and strength in controlling aromatic yields in lignin pyrolysis remains insufficiently understood. Here, three zeolite framework topologies, namely FAU, MFI, and BEA, with distinct acidity profiles were systematically evaluated for lignin pyrolysis to disentangle zeolite framework topology and acidity effects. Significant variations in bio-oil and non-oxygenated aromatics (benzene, toluene, xylene (BTXs), and napthalenes) yields demonstrated that framework topology-dependent acid site strength plays a more dominant role than acid site density (bulk/external) in enhancing aromatics yield. Thermogravimetric analysis revealed that primary lignin depolymerization is not responsible for the product distribution variations observed. Instead, secondary reactions of oxygenated lignin fragments with acid sites dictate the overall deoxygenation performance. H-ZSM-5 exhibited the highest aromatics yields (100–132 mg g-1lignin), followed by H-Beta (35–52 mg g-1 lignin) and H-Y (8–22 mg g-1 lignin) zeolites. These values correspond to 4 to 16 % of theoretical maximum BTXs ring utilization efficiency (RUE), a benchmark that we propose to evaluate catalyst efficiency in lignin pyrolysis, defined as the ratio of experimentally obtained BTXs to the theoretical maximum based on phenylpropanoid units (C9) in lignin. Regeneration studies revealed gradual catalyst deactivation due to the conversion of strong acid sites (SAS) to intermediate acid sites (IAS) resulting in lower BTXs RUE per cycle. Overall, this work highlights the role of zeolite framework topology-driven confinement effects in controlling the acid site strength and thereby, governing lignin pyrolysis performance.
items.authors: Devanshu Sajwan, Lucas Dorazio, Nils Bottke, Andrei N. Parvulescu, Matteo Monai, Bert M. Weckhuysen
items.title_zh: 通过建立结构-酸性-性能关系提升沥青烃产量
items.summary_zh: 选择性热解木质素为芳香烃仍然是一个主要挑战，因其高氧含量和结构复杂性。固体酸催化剂如沸石被广泛认为是热解过程中的有效催化剂。然而，酸位点密度和强度在控制木质素热解芳香烃产量中的作用尚不明确。本研究系统评估了三种不同酸性特征的沸石框架拓扑（FAU、MFI和BEA）对木质素热解的影响。结果显示，框架拓扑依赖的酸位点强度在提高芳香烃产量方面比酸位点密度更为重要。热重分析表明，主要的木质素降解并不是产物分布变化的原因，而是氧化木质素片段与酸位点的二次反应决定了整体脱氧性能。H-ZSM-5的芳香烃产量最高（100–132 mg g-1木质素），其次是H-Beta（35–52 mg g-1木质素）和H-Y（8–22 mg g-1木质素）沸石。这些值对应于理论最大BTXs环利用效率的4%至16%。

items.title: Coverages and Configurations of CO* and H* on Pt(111) under Realistic Reaction Conditions
items.abstract: Lateral interactions between co–adsorbed species can produce non-random spatial organization that governs the availability of reactive motifs relevant to catalytic behavior. For CO* and H* co–adsorbed on Pt(111), these interactions determine how the two species distribute across the surface and therefore which local CO*–H* configurations are available under reaction conditions. In this work, we combine density functional theory, cluster expansions, and grand canonical Monte Carlo simulations to determine how CO* and H* organize on Pt(111), and subsequently use electronic surface charge as a controlled perturbation to examine how this organization responds to changes in the underlying energetics. On neutral Pt(111), CO*–H* first-nearest-neighbor interactions are strongly repulsive (0.42 eV), CO*–CO* first-nearest-neighbor interactions are moderately repulsive (0.12 eV), and H*–H* interactions are comparatively weak. These interactions cause CO* to nucleate into islands that grow and coalesce with increasing CO* coverage, while H* preferentially occupies regions outside CO*-rich domains. Consequently, the abundance of CO*–H* nearest-neighbor configurations varies non-monotonically with CO* coverage, reaching a maximum at intermediate coverage before decreasing as CO* islands grow and the adsorbates become increasingly segregated. Positive surface charge strengthens CO* adsorption but also increases CO*–CO* repulsion, producing higher CO* coverages, a broader distribution of CO* island sizes, and larger low-coverage regions between islands where H* can adsorb away from CO*. This suppresses CO*–H* nearest-neighbor configurations relative to the neutral surface. Negative charging weakens CO* adsorption, producing lower CO* coverages, higher H* coverages, and less consolidated CO* islands, thereby increasing the prevalence of mixed CO*–H* local environments. At intermediate CO* coverage, CO* islands enter a regime of accelerated growth and coalescence that coincides with a shallow plateau in H* coverage. This coincidence suggests that the onset of CO* island coalescence is accompanied by a reorganization of the co-adsorbed layer. Further, it illustrates the strong influence of lateral interactions on the formation of potentially reactive motifs, highlighting how they become influential in determining catalytic reactivity.
items.authors: Sifat Hossain, Venkata Rohit Punyapu, Phillip Christopher, Rachel B. Getman
items.title_zh: Pt(111)上CO*与H*的覆盖与配置研究
items.summary_zh: 共吸附物种之间的侧向相互作用会导致非随机的空间组织，影响催化行为相关的反应性特征。在Pt(111)上共吸附的CO*和H*中，这些相互作用决定了两种物质在表面的分布，从而影响反应条件下可用的局部CO*–H*配置。本研究结合密度泛函理论、簇展开和广义经典蒙特卡洛模拟，探讨了CO*和H*在Pt(111)上的组织方式，并利用电子表面电荷作为控制扰动，研究这种组织如何响应底层能量的变化。在中性Pt(111)上，CO*–H*的第一近邻相互作用强烈排斥（0.42 eV），CO*–CO*的第一近邻相互作用适度排斥（0.12 eV），而H*–H*的相互作用相对较弱。这些相互作用导致CO*形成岛屿，并随着CO*覆盖的增加而生长和合并，而H*则优先占据CO*富集区域之外的区域。因此，CO*–H*的最近邻配置的丰度随CO*覆盖呈非单调变化，在中等覆盖时达到最大值，随后随着CO*岛屿的生长和吸附物的日益分离而减少。正的表面电荷增强了CO*的吸附。

items.title: Excitation-Energy Accuracy Does Not Guarantee Observable Fidelity: Rethinking Validation of Excited-State Quantum Algorithms
items.abstract: Excitation-energy accuracy is currently the dominant validation criterion for excited-state quantum algorithms. We show that this practice can conceal severe failures in physically relevant observables. Using quantum equation-of-motion (qEOM) as a representative case study, we demonstrate that excitation-energy accuracy and observable accuracy can become effectively decoupled. While both qEOM and Quantum Subspace Expansion (QSE) yield highly accurate excitation energies, their predictions for dipole moments differ dramatically, establishing observable fidelity as an independent benchmark dimension that cannot be inferred from energy agreement alone. To investigate the origin of this discrepancy, we introduce anti-Hermitized qEOM (AqEOM), an a posteriori anti-Hermitian transformation applied to the qEOM-derived state-transfer operator before direct property evaluation. Across multiple systems, AqEOM substantially improves dipole moments, state-overlap diagnostics, and reduced density matrix-based observables while leaving the underlying excitation-energy description essentially unchanged. These results demonstrate that excitation-energy accuracy does not guarantee observable accuracy and that energy-only validation can overlook significant failures in physically relevant properties. AqEOM provides a concrete mechanistic demonstration of this principle, highlighting observable fidelity as an independent benchmark dimension for excited-state quantum algorithms.
items.authors: Gyumin Kim, Youngsam Kim, Sehun Kim, Eunji Sim

items.title: Topochemical Fluorination of the Ruddlesden−Popper In/Sb-Mixed Oxide Ba2In0.5Sb0.5O4; Staged Anion Insertion and Structural Evolution toward the Fluorine-Rich Oxyfluoride Ba2In0.5Sb0.5O2F4
items.abstract: Layered Ruddlesden–Popper (RP) oxides provide a versatile platform for topochemical anion modification, enabling access to metastable mixed-anion phases with tuneable structural and electronic properties. In this work, we present a comprehensive investigation of how mixed B -site (indium and antimony) chemistry influences topochemical fluorination of Ba 2 In 0.5 Sb 0.5 O 4 using polyvinylidene fluoride (PVDF). Powder X-ray diffraction (PXRD) reveals anisotropic lattice expansion, dominated by elongation perpendicular to the perovskite layers, with minimal change in the in-plane lattice parameters. Fluorination proceeds through a composition-dependent multiphase regime in which several tetragonal ( I 4 /mmm ) RP components with progressively expanded c and slightly contracted a lattice parameters coexist, representing a distribution of fluorination states, followed by convergence to a single dominant fluorine-rich tetragonal phase at high fluorine content. Coupled X-ray/neutron Rietveld refinement establishes the end member as the anion-saturated oxyfluoride Ba 2 In 0.5 Sb 0.5 O 2 F 4 , and locates the three fully occupied anion sites of the tetragonal I 4 /mmm framework. The preferred O/F distribution, with oxide at the equatorial site and fluoride at the apical and interstitial sites, is supported by bond-valence-sums (BVSs) analysis of the refined interatomic distances and the corresponding global instability indices (GIIs), together with charge balance, since O and F cannot be reliably distinguished from their neutron scattering lengths alone. X-ray absorption near-edge structure (XANES) measurements support the retention of the formal In 3+ and Sb 5+ oxidation states upon fluorination.
items.authors: Shama Perween, Tolga Kocaer, Harol Moreno Fernández, Roland Schoch, Felix R. Fischer, Jana Timm

items.title: Hybrid Physics–Diagnostic Estimation of Liquid Loading for Wet-Gas Flowmeter Correction: A Model-Based Uncertainty Framework
items.abstract: The established wet-gas corrections express the indicated gas rate as the true rate multiplied by an over-reading factor that depends on the Lockhart–Martinelli parameter. At most production metering stations that parameter is not measured, so the correction cannot be closed from the meter signal alone. This paper treats liquid loading as a latent variable to be estimated rather than treating the over-reading as a quantity to be learned. A thermodynamic prediction from composition, pressure and temperature is combined with a structurally distinct estimate from flowmeter diagnostic signals already transmitted at the station, and their disagreement is quantified by an estimator consistency index governing whether the correction is applied. The study is computational: no wet-gas loop data were used, the diagnostic estimator is specified but not fitted, and every figure below is a modeled uncertainty rather than a measured accuracy. In a Monte Carlo study of 300,000 simulated realizations over a rich-gas envelope (60–85 kg/cm2, 30–60 °C), three results follow. Inverse-variance fusion degrades the estimate unless the thermodynamic estimator declares an allowance for upstream carryover it cannot observe; with that allowance and an asymmetric weighting, the simulated 95% band falls from ±5.45% to ±4.28%. The consistency index is a specific detector of that failure mode: carryover occurs in 25% of realizations but in 94% of those rejected. Because the two estimates are not statistically independent, the covariance term must be retained in the index; omitting it progressively disables the acceptance test. A falsifiable experimental protocol is specified.
items.authors: Leon Sandler

items.title: Artificial Intelligence-Assisted Dopant Discovery toward Air-Stable Sulfide Solid-State Electrolytes
items.abstract: Sulfide solid-state electrolytes (SSEs) are highly promising candidates for all-solid-state batteries (ASSBs), but the severe degradation triggered by moisture exposure remains a major obstacle to their large-scale application. Despite compositional doping could effectively enhance the air stability, there is currently no relevant screening strategy to support the efficient exploration of dopants. Herein, we develop an artificial intelligence-assisted dopant screening platform for air-stable sulfide SSEs (LPSC). Retrieval-augmented system combined with large language model could effectively prescreen the dopants that enhance both the ionic conductivity, and interfacial compatibility of the electrolyte. More importantly, the impact of dopants on the air stability of electrolytes was quantified by the minimum Gibbs free energy change () of the hydrolysis reaction, which could be predicted by a composition-based machine learning model. Guided by this strategy, several promising dopants, including BiF3, CoF3, InF3, and SnF4 were successfully identified. As a proof of concept, LPSC-BiF3 electrolyte demonstrates superior air stability, delivering a high ionic conductivity retention of 91% after exposure to air with 10% RH for 6 h. Consequently, the exposed LPSC-BiF3 electrolyte enabled excellent cycling stability in Li-In||NCM811 full cells. The proposed screening strategy significantly promotes the exploration of high-performance dopants for air-stable sulfide SSEs.
items.authors: Zhuo Chen, Lin Hong, Xi Zhang

items.title: Predicting spatiotemporal coke growth in an industrial ethane cracker with a hybrid mechanistic–neural surrogate of its plant-tuned SPYRO model
items.abstract: Coke accumulation on radiant coils sets the run length of steam-cracking furnaces, yet the thickness field cannot be measured in service, and rigorous simulators are proprietary and non-differentiable. We introduce a grey-box surrogate of a plant-calibrated SPYRO model for an industrial ethane cracker, forecasting the complete coke field across 52 axial segments over a 90-day run. It learns the coking rate as an explicit Arrhenius core modulated by a positive neural component and coke self-feedback, integrated over time to inherently ensure monotonic growth. On six held-out cases outside the training window in at least two operating variables, it reaches 0.034 ± 0.001 mm mean absolute error (R² = 0.9994, five seeds) with zero monotonicity violations; ablations show the guarantee costs no accuracy. Plant infrared data reproduce the encoded temperature trend. We close with limitations (unidentifiable embedded kinetics, narrow validity window, exogenous wall temperature) and demonstrate an online-estimator deployment using the analytic Jacobian.
items.authors: Hongtao Li, Hao Zhou, Jinshen Wang, Xiaochen Sun

items.title: The importance of nanoscale phenomena in electrolyte behavior: acetonitrile-aqueous zinc sulfate electrolytes
items.abstract: Electrolytes composed of mixed solvents are of significant scientific and technological importance in lithium-ion and beyond–lithium-ion batteries, and more broadly across physical chemistry. Their emergence has highlighted the importance of multiscale phenomena, particularly the development of nanoscale solution heterogeneities. It is therefore essential to assess how these inhomogeneities and nanoscale aggregates influence solvation, transport, and electronic properties. Here we investigate the solution structure and transport properties of aqueous zinc sulfate electrolytes with acetonitrile (ACN) additives, where the addition of ACN leads to improved cyclability. Using complementary anomalous small-angle X-ray scattering, X-ray pair distribution function, electrochemistry, and NMR, we identify the presence of salt-rich-water-rich and salt-poor-ACN-rich nano-heterogeneities, and at higher ACN concentrations, liquid-liquid phase separation. We find that the size of zinc-sulfate ion clusters in the water domains increases slightly upon ACN addition, while the ACN-rich domains grow much larger as phase separation is approached. The inverse Haven ratio, determined using the ionic conductivity and diffusivity, is much less than unity and decreases slightly on addition of ACN, which shows ion-ion interactions. We speculate that the increased ion-ion interactions with increased ACN is a result of a reduction in free water, the increase in zinc sulfate cluster size and/or an increase in solution tortuosity. This work highlights key phenomena to consider when engineering new water-organic-salt electrolyte systems and establishes a phase diagram for water-ACN-ZnSO4 that can guide advances, such as self-adaptive electrolytes.
items.authors: Emma N. Antonio, Luis Kitsu Iglesias, Kee Sung Han, Michael Counihan, Stefan Ilic, Mrinal K. Bera

items.title: ElastoGraph: An Open-Source Algorithmic Framework for the Topological Assessment of Molecular Stiffness Applied to Polysaccharide Networks
items.abstract: The prediction of mechanical properties at the molecular scale relies on matrix-based approaches, such as the diagonalization of large Hessian matrices in elastic network models (ENMs) or molecular dynamics (MD) simulations. These methods exhibit O(N3) computational complexity and map molecular connectivity to macroscopic stiffness through numerical operations that do not explicitly resolve load-transmission pathways. Here, we present 2 ElastoGraph, an open-source Python framework that shifts the analytical focus from numerical prediction to the topological mapping of elastic paths—the specific routes through which mechanical force is transmitted between terminal vertices. The algorithm achieves three objectives: (i) it identifies and prunes mechanically irrelevant subgraphs (r = 0) via cut-vertex analysis, isolating the subset of elastic paths that contribute to load transmission; (ii) it hierarchically classifies these paths using a k–d subgraph ranking based on graph distance and vertex-connectivity, providing a prioritized map of topological targets for chemical functionalization; and (iii) it computes effective elastic constants for series-parallel architectures through recursive edge reductions in O(N) time, while establishing rigorous topological bounds for non-series-parallel networks. Applied to the load-bearing backbones of cellulose and β-chitin, the framework reveals that under uniform edge weights both polysaccharides are topologically isomorphic, yielding an identical effective stiffness. However, the integration of a chemical parameterization module breaks this degeneracy: assigning relative stiffness values of k = 1.0 to covalent bonds and k = 0.10 to hydrogen bonds in cellulose, versus k = 0.15 for hydrogen bonds in β-chitin, yields differentiated mechanical profiles (keff = 0.45 for cellulose and keff = 0.52 for β-chitin). The framework computes these results in less than 0.01 s, representing an approximate 50-fold speedup compared to standard Hessian inversion on comparable synthetic networks. This framework complements molecular dynamics simulations by providing an interpretable topological baseline that identifies which bonds are worth functionalizing to tune macroscopic stiffness. Quantitative validation against experimental nanomechanical data will be the subject of future work. Beyond polysaccharides, this topology-driven framework is extensible to protein domains, DNA nanostructures, metal–organic frameworks, and two-dimensional materials, providing an interpretable baseline for the rational design of mechanically tunable molecular 3 systems across structural biology, soft matter, and nanotechnology. The source code, documentation, and benchmark datasets are freely available at https://github.com/yeyrecanals/ElastoGraph
items.authors: Martina Canet, Yamila García, Yamila Garcia-Martinez
items.title_zh: ElastoGraph：用于多糖网络分子刚度拓扑评估的开源算法框架
items.summary_zh: 分子尺度机械性质的预测依赖于基于矩阵的方法，如弹性网络模型（ENMs）中的大海森矩阵对角化或分子动力学（MD）模拟。这些方法的计算复杂度为O(N³)，通过数值运算将分子连接性映射到宏观刚度，但未明确解决载荷传递路径。本文提出了ElastoGraph，一个开源Python框架，重点转向弹性路径的拓扑映射，即机械力在终端顶点之间传递的具体路线。该算法实现了三个目标：（i）通过切点分析识别并修剪机械无关子图（r = 0），孤立出对载荷传递有贡献的弹性路径；（ii）基于图距离和顶点连通性，使用k-d子图排名对这些路径进行分层分类，提供化学功能化的优先拓扑目标图；（iii）通过递归边缘简化在O(N)时间内计算系列并联结构的有效弹性常数，同时为非系列并联网络建立严格的拓扑界限。该框架应用于纤维素和β-壳聚糖的承载骨架，揭示了其机械特性。

items.title: Hierarchical Encoding of Digital Data on DNA Origami Nanostructures with Topological Barcodes
items.abstract: DNA data storage has emerged as a promising route to managing the exponential growth in global data production. While sequence-based DNA data storage offers unprecedented storage densities, the high costs of DNA synthesis make it prohibitively expensive. As a more cost-efficient alternative, data can be stored in DNA origami nanostructures (DONs), which however comes with the disadvantage of dramatically reduced data densities. This work aims to increase the amount of data that can be stored in one DON sample by introducing topological barcodes to identify different data subsets by atomic force microscopy (AFM). Two barcoding approaches are compared based on either different DON shapes or a single shape with different notches that are generated by omitting groups of edge staples. Although the correct identification of barcodes is more difficult for the notch designs than for the DON shapes, the notch-based barcoding approach achieves more consistent and reliable data readout. At the same time, the notch-based barcoding approach is substantially more cost-efficient as it uses only a single set of staples, whereas the shape-based approach requires one staple set for each DON shape. Notch-based topographic barcodes thus represent a viable, low-cost approach for indexing data subsets in DON-based data storage.
items.authors: Lukas Rabbe, Omer Sella, Thomas Heinis, Adrian Keller

items.title: Accurate modeling of ion-protein binding in solution: molecular mechanics force field innovation and validation on Mg2+
items.abstract: Multivalent ions bind to proteins to control many biological processes. Molecular simulations can effectively supplement experiments to resolve underlying mechanisms, but suffer from reliability and feasibility issues in describing ion-protein binding in the condensed phase. Here we present a molecular mechanics based generalizable solution to this long-standing challenge. Using the divalent Mg 2+ as a model, we demonstrate that our approach yields unprecedented accuracy in describing its binding to proteins in solution – compared to high level quantum mechanics, the mean error in local interaction energies is 0.5%, and the binding modes and binding free energies match experiment. Our study also shows that key to achieving this accuracy requires a delicate balance between the large repulsive and attractive forces at short distances near ions for which explicit modeling of polarization is essential. Overall, our work lays foundation for future development of molecular simulation methods for ions and opens the way to quantitatively study Mg-dependent mechanisms in hundreds of enzymes and proteins.
items.authors: Giorgio Schillaci, Julian Mélendez Delgado, Matthew Saunders, Irene Arias Gutierrez, Péter R. Nagy, Sameer Varma
items.title_zh: 溶液中离子-蛋白质结合的精确建模：分子力学力场创新与验证
items.summary_zh: 多价离子通过与蛋白质结合来调控许多生物过程。分子模拟可以有效补充实验以揭示潜在机制，但在描述凝聚相中的离子-蛋白质结合时存在可靠性和可行性问题。本文提出了一种基于分子力学的通用解决方案，以二价镁离子（Mg²⁺）为模型，展示了我们的方法在描述其与蛋白质结合方面的前所未有的准确性——与高水平量子力学相比，局部相互作用能的平均误差为0.5%，结合模式和结合自由能与实验结果相符。研究表明，达到这种准确性需要在离子附近短距离内大排斥力和吸引力之间保持微妙平衡，显式建模极化是关键。总体而言，我们的工作为未来离子的分子模拟方法发展奠定了基础，并为定量研究数百种酶和蛋白质中的镁依赖机制开辟了新途径。

items.title: Polymer-Assisted One-Dimensional Dissolution in N‑Methylformamide Unlocks Highly Ordered Hybrid Bragg-Stack Clay-Poly(Ethylene Glycol) Oxygen Barriers
items.abstract: One-dimensional (1D) dissolution is a gentle and thermodynamically driven process that enables the spontaneous and utter delamination of layered materials into nematic suspensions of individual high aspect ratio nanosheets. This process is primarily known and extensively explored for aqueous systems. Examples of 1D dissolution in organic solvents are scarce and require selected organocations or complexation of the interlayer cation. This work demonstrates synergistic delamination of synthetic sodium fluorohectorite (NaHec; Na0.5inter [Li0.5Mg2.5]oct Si4 tet O10F2) in N-methylformamide (NMF) using poly (ethylene glycol) (PEG), which concomitantly acts as a complexing agent driving delamination and as the polymer matrix for a composite. Upon spray coating, the polymer is directly incorporated into a highly ordered hybrid Bragg-stack nanocomposite. The performance as a gas barrier was investigated for a range of PEG chain lengths [MW = 200, 400, 1500, 10000 g mol-1] using O2‑transmission rate measurements. With increasing MW, substantially reduced oxygen permeabilities (23°C, 75% r.h.) were observed, reaching values as low as 0.029 cm3 µm m‑2 d‑1 bar‑1, demonstrating the power of non-aqueous preparation of NaHec-PEG hybrid Bragg-stack nanocomposites.
items.authors: Max Stevenson, Alexandra Jourdain, Felix Uhlig, Sabine Rosenfeldt, Meike Kuhn, Eva M. Herzig
items.title_zh: 聚合物辅助的一维溶解实现高有序混合Bragg堆叠粘土-聚乙烯醇氧气屏障
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了在N-甲基甲酰胺（NMF）中，聚乙烯醇（PEG）辅助合成氟膨润土（NaHec）的协同剥离过程。该过程通过PEG作为复合材料的聚合物基体和剥离驱动剂，促使层状材料自发分散为高长宽比的纳米片。喷涂后，聚合物被直接纳入高有序的混合Bragg堆叠纳米复合材料中。通过氧气透过率测量，研究了不同分子量（200、400、1500、10000 g mol-1）的PEG链长对气体屏障性能的影响。随着分子量的增加，氧气渗透率显著降低（23°C，75%相对湿度），最低可达0.029 cm³ µm m⁻² d⁻¹ bar⁻¹，展示了非水相制备NaHec-PEG混合Bragg堆叠纳米复合材料的潜力。

items.title: Glycan-binding agglutination assays reveal key binding epitope of unknown lectins in Acinetobacter baumannii
items.abstract: Acinetobacter baumannii infections are associated with high mortality rates and an even higher prevalence of antimicrobial resistance. Understanding the lectin-glycan interactions mediating A. baumannii adhesion to cells will facilitate their exploitation in strategies to develop improved approaches to diagnosis and treatment. In this work, we use an established low-cost glycan-based agglutination assay to undertake a systematic structure-activity relationship screen of glycan ligands, and identify selective adhesion to α-GalNAc that is dependent upon both stereochemistry and presentation. Our work demonstrates how this approach can rapidly identify glycan motifs important to adhesion of understudied pathogens such as A. baumannii, information that is both therapeutically exploitable and furthers understanding of bacterial virulence.
items.authors: Jennifer Johns, Charlene Mae Cagape, Narisara Chantratita, James Spencer, M. Carmen Galan

items.title: A Molecular Generation–Validation Workflow Combining Reversible Junction Tree Reinforcement Learning and Semi-empirical Quantum Chemistry: A Case Study on Molecular Solar Thermal Fuels
items.abstract: Molecular generative models can rapidly explore chemical space, but conventional metrics alone do not establish whether proposed structures possess application-relevant physical properties. To address this limitation, we developed an integrated generationvalidation framework coupling Reversible Junction Tree Reinforcement Learning (RJT- RL) with automated density-functional tight-binding (DFTB) evaluation. Azobenzenebased molecular solar thermal fuels served as a representative case study. RJT-RL was guided by maximum Tanimoto similarity to a reference dataset, while reference and generated molecules were evaluated under identical DFTB calculation conditions to obtain the energy difference between the cis and trans isomers (∆ E iso ) and the S 0 → S 1 excitation energy (∆ E ex ). As training progressed, the ∆ E iso distribution extended toward higher values, while ∆ E ex values were more concentrated within the visible-light window, yielding candidates within the selected joint screening region, although neither descriptor was included in the reward. These results show that automated semi-empirical post-generation validation can identify candidates with targeted property combinations and reveal information beyond conventional molecular generation metrics.
items.authors: Qingyu Zhu, Ryan Lingg, Reuben Szabo, Tim Kowalczyk, Daisuke Yokogawa
items.title_zh: 结合可逆连接树强化学习与半经验量子化学的分子生成验证工作流程
items.summary_zh: 分子生成模型能够快速探索化学空间，但传统指标无法确定所提结构是否具备应用相关的物理性质。为解决这一局限，我们开发了一个集成的生成-验证框架，将可逆连接树强化学习（RJT-RL）与自动化密度泛函紧束缚（DFTB）评估相结合。以基于偶氮苯的分子太阳热燃料为案例研究，RJT-RL在最大Tanimoto相似度的指导下进行，参考分子和生成分子在相同的DFTB计算条件下进行评估，以获得顺式和反式异构体之间的能量差（∆E_iso）和S_0 → S_1激发能（∆E_ex）。随着训练的进行，∆E_iso分布向更高值扩展，而∆E_ex值则集中在可见光窗口内，产生了符合选定联合筛选区域的候选分子，尽管这两个描述符未包含在奖励中。这些结果表明，自动化的半经验后生成验证能够识别具有目标性质组合的候选分子，并揭示超越传统分子生成指标的信息。

items.title: Dynamic Parameter Screening for Accelerated Mechanistic Analysis
items.abstract: Mechanistic studies are essential for the continued advancement of the chemical sciences however; classical approaches remain laborious and material intensive. Graphical reaction analysis techniques such as RPKA and VTNA have substantially reduced this burden, yet the time and resources required to comprehensively study increasingly complex reactions remain high. Medium- and high-throughput batch and flow kinetic methods have been developed to further streamline data acquisition, but their widespread adoption is limited by the need for specialized equipment or expertise. Here we introduce dynamic parameter screening (DPS), in which a single batch reaction is monitored continuously while sequential reagent and catalyst additions are used to probe kinetic impacts of multiple species within one experimental setup. Using the palladium-catalyzed Kumada–Tamao–Corriu cross-coupling as a model system, we compared DPS with traditional one-factor-at-a-time approach across three catalytic systems (PdCl2(dppf)·CH2Cl2, PEPPSI-iPr, and XPhos Pd G2). DPS afforded essentially identical qualitative and quantitative (kinetic modeling) conclusions except for the case of XPhos Pd G2. This latter system exhibited multiple kinetic regimes where the traditional approach revealed the global impact of reagent concentrations, whereas DPS provided complementary, higher-resolution insight into reagent effects within a specific kinetic regime. The insights obtained from DPS guided a simple slow-dosing strategy that markedly improved reaction rates even at reduced catalyst loadings. DPS therefore provides a practical, low-barrier route to high-resolution kinetic information that is fully compatible with conventional modeling, broadening access to mechanistic understanding in resource-limited settings.
items.authors: Dylan J. Pyle, Finn Bork, Wesley McNutt, Ekaterina Trushina, Joshua S. Derasp, Sara M. Guzman
items.title_zh: 动态参数筛选加速机理分析研究
items.summary_zh: 机理研究对化学科学的持续发展至关重要，但传统方法仍然繁琐且耗材。图形反应分析技术如RPKA和VTNA显著减轻了这一负担，但全面研究日益复杂的反应所需的时间和资源仍然较高。为进一步简化数据获取，开发了中高通量的批量和流动动力学方法，但其广泛应用受限于对专用设备或专业知识的需求。本文介绍了动态参数筛选（DPS），通过在单一批量反应中持续监测，同时使用顺序试剂和催化剂添加来探测多种物质的动力学影响。以钯催化的Kumada–Tamao–Corriu交叉偶联反应为模型系统，我们将DPS与传统的单因素逐次法进行了比较。结果表明，DPS在定性和定量（动力学建模）结论上基本一致，除了XPhos Pd G2系统，该系统显示出多种动力学状态，传统方法揭示了试剂浓度的全球影响，而DPS则提供了更高分辨率的试剂效应洞察。

items.title: Nanovehicles Equipped with Triptycene-Fused Unidirectional Light-Driven Molecular Motors
items.abstract: The integration of molecular motors into increasingly complex functional architectures while preserving their dynamic behavior represents an important challenge in the development of molecular machinery. Herein, we report a modular synthetic platform for motorized nanovehicles based on a triptycene-fused overcrowded alkene molecular motor, orthogonal axles, trimethyladamantane-based wheels, and an optional flagellum-like appendage. Three nanovehicle architectures of increasing structural complexity were assembled using a convergent synthetic strategy. The photochemical and thermal behavior of the parent molecular motor was investigated by NMR and UV–vis spectroscopy, supported by X-ray crystallography and density functional theory calculations, and shown to proceed through a unidirectional four-stage rotary cycle. Importantly, the characteristic photoisomerization and thermal helix inversion processes were retained after incorporation of the motor into the nanovehicle framework. Furthermore, selected nanovehicle was immobilized on gold surfaces, where differential UV–vis spectroscopy demonstrated preservation of the photochemical and thermal responses observed in solution. The close correspondence between solution-phase and surface-confined behavior indicates effective decoupling of the motor unit from the metallic substrate by the trimethyladamantane wheels. These results establish a versatile platform for the construction of motorized nanovehicles and provide a foundation for future studies of molecular machines operating at interfaces.
items.authors: Guillaume Bastien, Kateřina Bezděková, Katarina Majerová Varga, Eva Kaletová, Lukáš Severa, Jakub Sochor
items.title_zh: 配备三苯并环单向光驱动分子马达的纳米载体
items.summary_zh: 本研究报告了一种模块化合成平台，用于基于三苯并环融合的拥挤烯烃分子马达的马达化纳米载体，采用正交轴、基于三甲基亚当烷的轮子和可选的鞭状附肢。通过收敛合成策略组装了三种结构复杂度逐渐增加的纳米载体架构。利用核磁共振和紫外-可见光光谱研究了母体分子马达的光化学和热行为，并通过X射线晶体学和密度泛函理论计算进行了支持，显示其经过单向四阶段旋转循环。重要的是，马达嵌入纳米载体框架后，特征性的光异构化和热螺旋反转过程得以保留。此外，选定的纳米载体被固定在金表面上，差异紫外-可见光光谱表明在溶液中观察到的光化学和热响应得以保持。这些结果表明，三甲基亚当烷轮有效地将马达单元与金属基底解耦。

items.title: Enzymatic routes to site-specific protein-nucleic acid conjugates
items.abstract: Nature rarely joins nucleic acids to proteins covalently, yet synthetic protein-nucleic acid conjugates enable diverse applications from nanotechnology to therapeutics, which require or benefit from defined, stable, one-to-one linkages of known geometry. Here I evaluate biochemical routes to such conjugates against four ideals: enzymatic bond formation, addressability on both partners, minimal engineering of the protein of interest, and scarless linkage to unmodified nucleic acid. With an eye on biochemical mechanisms, I cover both established tools and natural systems that might become one. The available methods fall into two broad architectures. In cis, the enzyme itself becomes part of the product, allowing native chemistry on unmodified nucleic acid but requiring a folded fusion, usually at a terminus. In trans, a separate enzyme modifies the target protein and leaves a short motif, but the burden often shifts to the nucleic acid, which must carry a reactive group. No current method satisfies all four ideals, and the trade-offs largely reflect the substrate class recognized by the bond-forming enzyme. Nucleic-acid readers offer the most direct route to scarless, fully enzymatic conjugation but their requirement for large fusions limit protein-side addressability. Small-molecule readers invert this profile, enabling compact tags and greater placement flexibility at the cost of synthetic handles and a chemical final bond. Peptide readers combine short tags with enzymatic ligation but constrain attachment geometry and linkage chemistry. Site-specific, minimally invasive, scarless, and fully biochemical ProNAc formation therefore remains a tetralemma, with enzymatic activation of nucleic acids offering a promising route toward resolving it.
items.authors: Maximilian J.L.J. Fürst
items.title_zh: 酶促合成特定位点蛋白-核酸结合物的途径
items.summary_zh: 自然界中，核酸与蛋白质的共价结合极为罕见，但合成的蛋白-核酸结合物在纳米技术和治疗学等领域具有广泛应用，这些应用需要或受益于已知几何形状的稳定一对一连接。本文评估了实现此类结合物的生化途径，依据四个理想标准：酶促键合、双方的可寻址性、对目标蛋白的最小工程改造，以及与未修饰核酸的无痕连接。现有方法主要分为两种架构：在顺式中，酶本身成为产物的一部分，允许在未修饰核酸上进行本征化学反应，但通常需要在末端进行折叠融合；在反式中，独立酶修饰目标蛋白并留下短序列，但通常会将负担转移到核酸上，后者必须携带反应性基团。目前没有任何方法能满足所有四个理想标准，权衡主要反映了键合酶所识别的底物类别。核酸识别因子提供了无痕、完全酶促结合的最直接途径，但其对大融合的需求限制了蛋白侧的可寻址性。小分子识别因子则反转了这一特征，允许紧凑标签和更大的放置灵活性。

items.title: There is Room in the Middle: Unidirectional Energy Transfer in Plasmonic Nanohybrids through Intermediate Coherence
items.abstract: Plasmon-induced resonance energy transfer (PIRET) is less well-known than hot carrier and polaritonic photocatalysis. The small dipole moment of individual excitons means donors and acceptors are weakly coupled in molecular energy transfer, so it is considered not efficient as hot carrier photocatalysis. And unlike the detailed quantum descriptions for polaritons in vibrational and electronic strong coupling, there is not a clear mechanistic model for PIRET. Here, we establish the underlying mechanism of PIRET and show energy transfer efficiencies of up to 75%. Gold nanorod (AuNR)-methylene blue polymer nanohybrids with identical plasmon resonance energies but with systematically varied core sizes enable direct comparison of the competing roles of oscillator strength and dephasing. Operando single-particle spectroelectrochemistry is used to quantify PIRET efficiencies. Open-quantum and classical electrodynamics simulations reveal that smaller AuNRs have an advantage because they combine stronger eigenmode-normalized local coupling with slower plasmon dephasing. PIRET efficiency increases from 30% to 75% with optimized AuNR sizes. The unique oscillator properties of AuNRs establish intermediate coherence, between more familiar weakly and strongly coupled regimes, as an effective route to unidirectional plasmon-to-exciton transfer. Intermediate coherence is a kinetic gate for PIRET, creating an efficient way to transform light into chemical degrees of freedom through which further photocatalysis is possible.
items.authors: Hyuncheol Oh, Md Ashiqur Rahman, Jaekak Yoo, Emily A. Cook, Diana Soto, Zhenyang Jia
items.title_zh: 中间态的空间：等离子体纳米杂化物中的单向能量转移
items.summary_zh: 等离子体诱导共振能量转移（PIRET）相较于热载流子和极化子光催化知之甚少。由于单个激子的小偶极矩，供体和受体在分子能量转移中耦合较弱，因此其效率被认为不如热载流子光催化。本文建立了PIRET的基本机制，并展示了高达75%的能量转移效率。采用具有相同等离子体共振能量但核心尺寸系统变化的金纳米棒（AuNR）-美蓝聚合物纳米杂化物，直接比较了振荡强度和去相干的竞争作用。通过操作单颗粒光谱电化学量化PIRET效率。开放量子和经典电动力学模拟表明，较小的AuNR因其结合了更强的本征模式归一化局部耦合和较慢的等离子体去相干而具有优势。优化AuNR尺寸后，PIRET效率从30%提高至75%。AuNR的独特振荡特性在熟悉的弱耦合和强耦合区域之间建立了中间相干，为单向等离子体到激子的转移提供了有效途径。

items.title: Unmasking the Non-Covalent Nature of HA–Dopamine Assemblies: Insights from 1H NMR Degradation Tracking and Multidimensional NMR
items.abstract: Hyaluronic acid (HA) is a polysaccharide with diverse clinical and industrial applications. One of the key challenges is its sensitivity to enzymatic degradation. Chemical modifications offer a potential for modulating enzymatic susceptibility, as well as other functional properties. We report an NMR-based examination of the effect of HA modifications on hyaluronidase degradation. Chemical modification of HA with dopamine (HADN) has been widely reported, based on 1-ethyl-3-(3 dimethylaminopropyl) carbodiimide hydrochloride (EDC) chemistry. We describe a 1H NMR strategy for a convenient and sensitive analysis of hyaluronidase degradation rates. Surprisingly, HADN exhibited a degradation profile nearly identical to that of native HA, while methacrylated HA resisted degradation. The finding that HADN showed no protective effect prompted a rigorous re-investigation of HADN using 2D NMR. Our findings revealed that HADN is not a covalent conjugate, but a non-covalent and reversible system involving an unexpected EDC-dopamine adduct. Thermal and alkaline stress facilitate the release of dopamine from the non-covalent HADN complex. Our data highlight risks in the use of EDC-based conjugation experiments applied to many types of polysaccharides. Our NMR methods provide a robust platform for the dynamic comparison of degradation rates of HA, and identify a fingerprint test for characteristic residual EDC adducts.
items.authors: Xingang Liu, Derk J. Wiersma, Alessia Lasorsa, Pieter van der Meulen, Adrivit Mukherjee, Patrick C.A. van der Wel
items.title_zh: 揭示HA-多巴胺组装体的非共价特性：基于1H NMR降解追踪的见解
items.summary_zh: 透明质酸（HA）是一种具有多种临床和工业应用的多糖，其对酶降解的敏感性是一个主要挑战。化学修饰有助于调节酶的易感性及其他功能特性。我们采用NMR方法研究HA修饰对透明质酸酶降解的影响。基于1-乙基-3-(3-二甲氨基丙基)氨基甲酸盐（EDC）化学的HA与多巴胺的化学修饰（HADN）被广泛报道。我们描述了一种1H NMR策略，用于便捷且灵敏地分析透明质酸酶的降解速率。令人惊讶的是，HADN的降解特征与天然HA几乎相同，而甲基丙烯酸化HA则抵抗降解。HADN未显示保护作用，促使我们使用2D NMR对其进行严格再研究。结果表明，HADN并非共价结合物，而是涉及意外的EDC-多巴胺加合物的非共价可逆系统。热和碱性应力促进了多巴胺从非共价HADN复合物的释放。我们的数据强调了在多种多糖的EDC结合实验中存在的风险。我们的NMR方法为HA降解速率的动态比较提供了稳健的平台，并识别出特征测试。

items.title: Multiscale Insights into CO2 Chemisorption and Proton Transfer in Choline-Imidazolate based Deep Eutectic solvents: Exploring the Effect of Primary, Secondary and Tertiary Alkanolamine on Reaction Pathways and Product Distribution
items.abstract: Understanding how solvent composition governs competitive CO2 chemisorption within solvents is essential for the rational design of solvents for CO2 capture. In this work, we combine density functional theory (DFT), classical molecular dynamics (cMD), and microkinetic modeling to investigate CO2 chemisorption in choline-imidazolate based systems containing different alkanolamine hydrogen bond donors (HBDs): monoethanolamine (MEA), diethanolamine (DEA), and methyldiethanolamine (MDEA). By systematically characterizing the thermodynamics, kinetics and liquid structure influence, our results show that within these systems, choline is the preferred CO2-binding site unless a HBD is present. Accordingly, the MEA system shifts almost entirely to amine-centered carbamate formation, the DEA system retains carbamate dominance but with stronger competition from choline-centered capture, and the MDEA system which additionally includes water shifts back toward choline-centered carbonate together with a competitive water-assisted bicarbonate pathway. The findings illustrate how CO2 chemisorption in multicomponent liquids is controlled by a combination of intrinsic reaction thermodynamics, liquid-structure, and CO2 concentration. More broadly, this work provides insights that will facilitate molecular-level design of solvents for CO2 uptake and regeneration.
items.authors: Osasumwen J. Ikponmwosa, S.M Gulam Rabbani, Stephen P. Vicchio, Rachel B. Getman

items.title: Dinuclear Gold Photocatalyzed Atom-Transfer σ-Bond Metathesis and Sequential Heck-type Coupling
items.abstract: A dinuclear gold photocatalytic approach for strain-release σ-bond metathesis has been developed by combining inner-sphere electron transfer (ISET) and radical ligand transfer (RLT) mechanisms. This strategy facilitates atom-transfer reactions via C–I bond cleavage, radical translocation, and ligand transfer, yielding a wide range of spirocyclobutyl oxindoles with excellent substrate diversity and atom economy. Additionally, the produced C(sp 3 )–I bond functions as a versatile handle for selective Heck-type coupling with alkenes. Mechanistic investigations indicate a combined ISET-RLT pathway, where sequential excitation and excited-state aurophilic interactions between high-valent gold centers weaken the Au–I bond and enable ligand transfer. Gramscale synthesis and further derivatizations highlight the synthetic utility of this methodology.
items.authors: Sourav Pal, Pintu Kumbhakar, Theertha Babu T, Malekul Islam, Suman De Sarkar

items.title: Failure-Mode-Driven Methodology to Unravel Interfacial Chemical Bonding in Laser-Welded Polyamide-6.6–Titanium Interfaces
items.abstract: The demand for hybrid polymer-metal assemblies is growing worldwide, addressing challenges in fields such as biomedical implants. Among assembling techniques, laser welding is gaining attention for its quick processing, minimal pretreatment, high design freedom, and reproducibility. While these assemblies show strong mechanical resistance, understanding the root causes of adhesion—particularly potential chemical bonds at the interface—remains challenging, especially for thick assemblies. Previous work suggests breaking assemblies and dissolving the remaining polymer on the metallic surface to access the interface, an approach effective for cohesive failure modes. Here, we explore assemblies with mixed or adhesive failure modes using this breaking-and-dissolving combination. Results suggest that the methodology for accessing interfaces should be adapted to the assembly's failure mode: breaking and dissolving for cohesive failure, but breaking alone for mixed or adhesive failure. Both approaches were tested on laser-welded thick polyamide-6.6/titanium assemblies exhibiting a mixed failure mode. Interfaces were analyzed using XPS and ToF-SIMS. The methodology successfully provided access to interfacial molecular information, supporting previous findings that show the formation of a C-O-Ti bond at the interface resulting from laser welding.
items.authors: P. Hirchenhahn, A. Al Sayyad, J. Bardon, P. Plapper, L. Houssiau, Pierre HIRCHENHAHN

items.title: Analytical topological bounds and favorable elastic paths in discrete molecular networks
items.abstract: The mechanical response of discrete networks is fundamentally governed by their underlying connectivity. While traditional matrix-based approaches successfully capture global mechanical responses, their utility is delimited by an 𝒪(𝑁3)computational cost that limits direct access to specific topological pathways and localized load transmission. Here, we formulate a graph-theoretical framework that determines the effective elastic constant of molecular networks through analytical topological rules, bypassing global matrix diagonalization. Central to this formulation is the concept of favorable elastic paths—the specific topological highways that actively transmit mechanical force between terminal vertices. For series-parallel architectures, we compute effective stiffness via recursive edge reductions characterized by excluded minors. To quantify localized mechanical contributions, we introduce a normalized Relevance Ratio and a hierarchical (𝑘, 𝑑)-subgraph classification based on graph distance and vertex connectivity. For complex, non-reducible topologies, we leverage Menger's theorem to derive rigorous topological upper and lower bounds for the effective stiffness using purely combinatorial opera tions. By mapping atoms and bonds to vertices and edges, we demonstrate how discrete connectivity dictates continuum mechanical response. This topology-driven approach provides a computationally efficient (𝒪(∣ 𝐸 ∣)) and analytically transparent baseline, opening new avenues for the algorithmic screening and targeted chemical functionalization of complex biopolymer networks and mechanical metamaterials.
items.authors: G. Pons, Y. García, Yamila Garcia-Martinez

items.title: Processing–structure–property relationships of Y2O3- and ZnO-modified MgO–Al2O3–SiO2 glasses for high-modulus fiber drawing
items.abstract: Magnesium aluminosilicate (MAS) glasses are attractive candidates for high-modulus (HM) reinforcing fibres but are prone to crystallisation, which restricts the usable forming window. Four MAS compositions modified with Y2O3 (T9, V9) or a combined Y 2 O 3 /ZnO addition (T10, V10) were investigated on a single experimental platform to define the window for crystallisation-free fibre drawing. Two base glasses were compared: an MgO-rich, Al 2 O 3 -lean variant (T series) and an Al 2 O 3 -rich, MgO-lean variant (V series). Compositions were verified by ICP-OES/MS, and characterised by dilatometry, DSC, rotational viscometry with Vogel–Fulcher–Tammann fits, gradient-furnace liquidus measurement and X-ray diffraction. The V series shows a glass transition 30–40 K above the T series and a 20 % lower thermal expansion coefficient. Substituting half of the Y 2 O 3 by ZnO lowers the glass transition by 13–30 K and raises the liquidus of the Al 2 O 3 -rich base from 1311 to 1340 °C. The DSC crystallisation onset lies a near-constant 33–37 K above the glass transition across all four glasses, indicating a kinetic barrier set by the MAS network rather than by the modifiers. All four were drawn into fully amorphous continuous fibres from nozzle temperatures only 40–69 K above their liquidus, and remain calorimetrically indistinguishable from the parent glass; V10, drawn 40 K above the highest liquidus, is the most stringent case. Crystallisation-free forming is therefore controlled by the rapid quench inherent to filament drawing rather than by a positive thermodynamic margin. The results support Y 2 O 3 -rich, Al 2 O 3 -rich compositions for HM-MAS fibre scale-up.
items.authors: Muawia Dafir, Holger Cebulla, Martin Kilo

items.title: Uni-Macro-FRPN: Full-Resolution and Cross-Scale Learning for Polymers
items.abstract: Polymer properties are governed by interactions across scales. Existing polymer models commonly retain either monomer chemistry without the polymer graph, or the polymer graph with simplified monomer chemistry. Here, we present Uni-Macro-FRPN (FRPN), a Full-Resolution Polymer Network unifying atom-level and within-monomer structural encoding with an explicit monomer-instance graph of a polymer chain. Its two Transformers jointly learn atom-informed monomer semantics, sequence order, and chain topology. Using BigSMILES to construct monomer semantics and polymer graphs, FRPN achieves 86.4% accuracy and 90.6% ROC–AUC on Block Copolymer Database (BCDB) lamellar-versus-non-lamellar classification, outperforming the evaluated baselines and supporting joint reasoning over monomer semantics and chain structure. Ablation results support a contribution from joint representation beyond the tested increases in parameter count. On the linear homopolymer benchmark, monomer-centric learning remains competitive, identifying a boundary case in which polymer-scale organization is relatively simple. In addition, existing models are primarily developed around linear polymers. To test whether this full-chain representation generalizes beyond linear polymers, we construct an all-atom moleculardynamics (MD) benchmark of 1640 datapoints spanning diverse monomer chemistries, sequence orderings, chain topologies, and physical properties. FRPN achieves the strongest overall performance on this topology-rich benchmark, and the accompanying diagnostics suggest a benefit from jointly modeling monomer chemistry and polymer structure within one architecture. Taken together, FRPN provides a practical route for moving polymer representation learning beyond SMILESbased descriptions by using BigSMILES to connect monomer semantics with explicit polymer-chain topology, and establishes a foundation for full-chain, cross-scale polymer modeling. Its leading overall performance among the evaluated models on both the real-world BCDB benchmark and the topology-rich MD benchmark further suggests a promising direction for polymer informatics: future polymer prediction models should treat polymers not only as collections of monomer descriptors, but as complete multiscale chemical and topological objects.
items.authors: Jintao Wu, Yiran Shan, Rui Zhang

items.title: Comparative Characterization of Nitrogen–Nitrogen Bond-Forming Piperazate Synthases to Improve Activity and Precision
items.abstract: Piperazate synthases (PZSs) have recently gained attention as enzymes that catalyze the formation of nitrogen-nitrogen bonds, offering a sustainable alternative to traditional synthesis of substituted hydrazines. Although progress has been made in elucidating their structure and mechanism, an exhaustive study characterizing multiple PZSs regarding their activity or tendency toward side reactions under varying conditions has yet to be conducted. In this study, we profiled the activity of eight purified PZSs under 80 different conditions each, covering pH, buffers, salinity, temperature dependence, and thermal stability, using automated liquid handling and a colorimetric substrate consumption assay. We also performed kinetic and structural analysis of the two most promising PZSs and used LC-MS to quantitatively investigate the substrate scope and side reactions. Among the investigated enzymes, we identified two highly active synthases, SbPZS from Streptomyces sp. B93 and SgPZS from Streptomyces griseochromogenes. Both enzymes tolerated a broad range of reaction conditions, but differed in their side-product formation rates. We found this tendency to be sequence-dependent and controlled by pH. These findings provide detailed information regarding the in vitro applicability of PZSs and will improve their use in (chemo-)enzymatic cascades for synthesizing pharmaceutical building blocks.
items.authors: Simon Schröder, Lan Julij Zadravec, Nikita Pal, Angelina Osipyan, Hanna Mozer, Simon P. Godehard

items.title: Origin-of-life chemistry is a problem of chemical composability
items.abstract: Life is usually described by biological functions such as metabolism, replication and evolution. A complementary chemical question lies upstream: what properties of a chemical world make such functions physically realizable? No single interaction strength, solvent property or temperature can answer this because persistence, exchange, reaction, transport and driven organization impose competing requirements. Compatibility may occur under one condition or across an ordered environmental history, provided useful states survive between stages. Autonomy emerges not through environmental independence, but as more constraints coordinating chemical flux are generated and maintained by the system itself. We propose a chemistry-first diagnostic programme mapping molecular failure modes, constructive trajectories and system-generated constraints across scales, from molecular interactions to reaction networks and selfmaintaining organization.
items.authors: Hengyue Xu

items.title: Hydrogenation of C–C Multiple Bonds with Simple Calcium Salts
items.abstract: Hydrogenation is among the most widely used transformations in chemical synthesis, yet it typically relies on precious transition-metal catalysts, pressurised hydrogen gas and an excess of solvents. Here we report a solvent-free, transition-metal-free hydrogenation method based on mixtures of simple, commercially available calcium salts (CaH 2 with Ca(OH) 2 or CaCO 3 ). Under mechanochemical conditions, calcium hydride reacts with calcium hydroxide or carbonate to generate H 2 in situ, eliminating the need for an external hydrogen source. The system efficiently hydrogenates alkenes, alkynes and aromatic hydrocarbons, including tetrasubstituted alkenes and benzene. Mechanistic studies support reversible hydrocalciation at the calcium hydride surface followed by irreversible hydrogenolysis with in situ generated H 2 . The method was demonstrated to be general, with the hydrogenation of 16 examples proceeding with an average of 74% yield, providing a safe, cheap and practical alternative to transition metal-catalysed hydrogenation of carbon-carbon multiple bonds.
items.authors: Rebecca Majchrzak, Fabian Kallmeier, Edgar Zander, Liesa Eickhoff, Jamie Hicks

items.title: Resolving Positional Markush Structures for Chemical Reaction Extraction
items.abstract: The automated extraction of chemical reaction data from scientific literature remains very challenging mainly due to the visual complexity and heterogeneity of published graphical schemes. In particular, substrate scopes containing positional Markush structures pose a significant challenge for current Optical Chemical Structure Recognition (OCSR) and reaction-extraction systems, as their resolution requires combining molecular recognition with precise spatial reasoning. Herein, we introduce a deterministic, coordinate-based extraction pipeline designed to resolve positional Markush structures in reaction schemes. Building upon a fine-tuned version of the graph-prediction OCSR module MolScribe, our approach uses deterministic geometric rules based on 2D molecular coordinates to infer R-group attachment points and generate topologically valid molecular representations. To evaluate this approach, we introduce two curated benchmarks: MIPub-2k (Molecular Images from Publication - Université Bourgogne Europe) comprising 2,128 literature-derived molecular image crops for OCSR evaluation and MIReactPub (Markush template-based Image of Reaction from Publication – Université Bourgogne Europe) comprising 450 reactions from 23 schemes containing positional Markush structures for reaction-level assessment. The complete pipeline achieves an end-to-end F1 score of 0.46, increasing to 0.54 for schemes without textual-dependent ambiguities. Slightly reorganizing figures doubles the F1 score, demonstrating the robustness of the underlying geometric resolution while highlighting the substantial impact of visual heterogeneity in published literature on end-to-end performance. By explicitly encoding chemical and spatial constraints, our proposed approach provides a transparent and reproducible framework for resolving complex molecular representations from literature images. The resulting open-source pipeline and benchmarks provide a specialized component that can be further integrated into automated workflows for large-scale chemical information extraction.
items.authors: Ulrick Fineddie Randriharimanamizara, Atif Anwer, Julien Roger, Fabrice Meriaudeau, Paul Fleurat-Lessard

items.title: Morita-Baylis-Hillman Allyl-Aryl Sulfoxides for the Dual Functionalization of Indoles via Interrupted Pummerer Rearrangement: Unlocking its Anticancer Potential
items.abstract: Employing Morita-Baylis-Hillman derived trisubstituted allyl aryl sulfoxides for a one-step dual vicinal functionalisation of indoles for the first time towards the synthesis of 3-aryl-thio-2-allyl indoles. The reaction proceeds via sulfoxide activation, nucleophilic attack of indole and a charge-accelerated [3,3]sigmatropic rearrangement. Selected compounds from the synthesized library showed significant anticancer activity against MDA-MB-7 cell lines with low toxicity towards normal MCF-10A cell line highlighting their potential as anticancer agents.
items.authors: Aishwarya Subramanian, Trinadh Ballanki, Siddireddi Kalyanram, Vaishnu Suresh Kumar, Mohit Garg, Diego Quezada

items.title: What survives? Semantic eligibility, distribution shift and metric interpretation in external validation of ADMET predictors
items.abstract: Machine-learning models for absorption, distribution, metabolism, excretion and toxicity (ADMET) are usually reported on benchmark splits drawn from the same curated collections used to train them. External validation is rarer, and when it is attempted, the assumption that a public dataset carrying a matching endpoint name is a valid comparator for a model output is seldom examined. We applied a pre-specified, fail-closed semantic eligibility screen — ten declared gates covering biological endpoint, matrix, species, assay family, measurement direction, result semantics, units, transformation, classification threshold and positive class — to twelve candidate pairings between three public experimental datasets and the outputs of ADMET-AI 2.0.1. The screen was executed before any metric was computed. Three pairings were accepted; nine were rejected, each with a recorded reason, and no classification endpoint qualified. On the three accepted pairings, after excluding exact structure overlap with the endpoint training source and with the reconstructed regression multitask universe, performance was poor to moderate: human liver microsomal clearance R² = −0.156 (95% CI −0.217 to −0.108; n = 366), logD at pH 7.4 R² = 0.368 (0.261 to 0.456; n = 474), and human plasma protein binding R² = 0.642 (0.543 to 0.732; n = 178). The model nevertheless outperformed both a training-set-mean baseline and a 1-nearest-neighbour Morgan/Tanimoto baseline on every accepted endpoint, including microsomal clearance, where the mean baseline gave R² = −0.270 and the nearest-neighbour baseline R² = −0.278. Two mechanisms accounted for the pattern. Label-distribution shift between the reconstructed training labels and the external labels was severe for clearance (Kolmogorov–Smirnov D = 0.446) and mild for logD (D = 0.095). Prediction-range compression was extreme for clearance, where predictions had 9% of the observed standard deviation and a calibration slope of 0.037, and moderate for logD (0.781; slope 0.545) and plasma protein binding (0.725; slope 0.599). Chemical novelty explained little (Spearman ρ between maximum training similarity and absolute error, −0.13 to −0.28). Conclusions were unchanged by structure-level aggregation, a structure-clustered bootstrap, restriction to stereochemically unambiguous records, and the inclusion of low-clearance measurements that the original benchmark had excluded before inference. We conclude that assay semantics must be screened before external metrics are computed, and that under strong label-distribution shift R² alone misrepresents model utility; rank correlation, bias, calibration slope and baseline-relative performance should be reported alongside it.
items.authors: Md. Rahul Reza Roktim

items.title: From Fluorine Substructures to Compound Identities: Bayesian Analysis of Multidescriptor 19F NMR Measurements in Multiple Solvents
items.abstract: Targeted liquid chromatography–tandem mass spectrometry quantifies only a few dozen fluorinated analytes and requires an authentic standard for each, so most of the organofluorine in environmental extracts is never assigned to a structure. Fluorine-19 NMR is an attractive complement because every fluorine nucleus responds independently of ionization and in proportion to its abundance, but existing 19 F libraries record chemical shift alone, in inconsistent solvents, and without the statistical search tools needed for 25 identification. Here we report a 19 F NMR spectral library of 163 fluorinated compounds—PFAS, pesticides, pharmaceuticals, and other fluorinated species—measured under three defined solvent conditions and annotated at the level of the individual fluorine nucleus with chemical shift, scalar coupling, multiplicity, and transverse relaxation time. We introduce the solvent-induced shift vector (SISV), the change in chemical shift of a resonance between solvent systems, as a descriptor that discriminates local fluorine environments that a single-solvent shift cannot resolve. Annotated resonances are mapped onto HOSE substructure codes and searched with a Bayesian framework that reports a likelihood ratio for each candidate structure together with an explicit ambiguity count, so that evidence strength and identification specificity are reported separately. Validation against synthetic mixtures establishes which descriptors contribute discriminating information and where the spectrum supports only a substructure class; application to an industrial wastewater extract demonstrates candidate prioritization under realistic, nonideal matrix conditions.
items.authors: Tristan S. Vick, Johnathan Stasi-Welsh, Diana S. Aga, Alexander C. Hoepker

items.title: Bio-Based Levoglucosenone Enables Regioisomer-Driven Inversion of Optical Activity in Polymers via Stereoselective Thia-Michael Addition of 1,2- and 1,3-Benzenedithiols
items.abstract: Levoglucosenone (LGO), a biobased platform molecule derived from cellulose waste, offers a versatile scaffold owing to its cyclic acetal bridge and reactive enone functionalities. Building on our previous work on stereoselective polymer formation from LGO, this study explores the incorporation of regioisomeric benzenedithiols (1,3- and 1,2-) via thia-Michael addition to afford structurally defined LGO-based monomers. These monomers were subsequently polycondensed with dicarboxylic dihydrazides to yield degradable polyhydrazones with well-defined stereochemistry. Notably, the regioisomeric structure of benzenedithiols induces a striking inversion of optical activity in the resulting polymers, demonstrating that the sign of the optical rotation can be controlled through monomer connectivity. This finding highlights a new strategy for tuning polymer properties from a single bio-based building block. The physicochemical, thermal, optical, and aqueous degradation properties of the resulting polymers were comprehensively characterized. In addition, the synthetic procedures have been optimized to improve sustainability by replacing hazardous solvents with greener alternatives.
items.authors: Francesco Raboni, Shinji Kudo, Takayuki Doi, Alessandro Pellis, Atsushi Tahara

items.title: Per-axis failure of the minimum-image convention in GCMC screening of MOFs for hydrogen storage
items.abstract: Grand canonical Monte Carlo (GCMC) simulations underpin machine-learning-accelerated screening of metal–organic frameworks (MOFs) for hydrogen storage, yet published workflows differ widely in simulation rigour.
